import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/training_9.csv"
]

# Note: Source2 (training_2.csv) is NOT included in the UNION operation as per operation_history

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all DataFrames vertically
# All source tables have the same schema ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# Target schema: ['admit': int, 'gre': int, 'gpa': float, 'prestige': int]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
target_df['admit'] = target_df['admit'].astype(int)
target_df['gre'] = target_df['gre'].astype(int)
target_df['gpa'] = target_df['gpa'].astype(float)
target_df['prestige'] = target_df['prestige'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
